page_title: PAL 1-1 RMA | Las Palmas v Real Madrid 29/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.

90+4' A cross by Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.

90+3' Endrick (Real Madrid) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
90+2' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
90+1' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
89' Viti (Las Palmas) has a goal ruled out for offside!
88' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.

86' A clever short pass gives Endrick (Real Madrid) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
86' Substitution. Endrick (Real Madrid) on for Vinicius Junior.

85' The opposition can't get near Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
85' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
84' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
84' Viti (Las Palmas) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer saw the whole situation.
81' Luis Carrion has decided to make a change. Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) replaces Kirian Rodriguez.
81' Substitution. Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jose Campana walks off.
80' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
80' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
78' It will be a substitution. Jaime Mata (Las Palmas) is ready to enter the pitch as Oliver McBurnie walks off.
78' Luis Carrion has decided to substitute Sandro Ramirez and he is replaced by Viti (Las Palmas).
76' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards goal, but Jasper Cillessen makes a magnificent save!
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) replaces Lucas Vazquez.
74' Luis Carrion is stunned as referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
74' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Las Palmas.
73' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mateo Busquets Ferrer no option but to blow his whistle.
73' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well over the bar.
72' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
72' Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Las Palmas.
72' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) swings in a cross from the corner, but Thibaut Courtois reads it well and gathers the ball.

71' Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Thibaut Courtois. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.

71' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
70' Mateo Busquets Ferrer couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Las Palmas.
70' Good clearance! Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
69' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Jasper Cillessen no chance!
68' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

67' The referee blows his whistle after Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. It's a penalty! Real Madrid have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
67' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
67' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
66' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
64' Here is a change. Luka Modric is going off and Carlo Ancelotti gives the last tactical orders to Arda Guler (Real Madrid).

62' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
62' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a strong challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul.
61' A substitution has been made. Alberto Moleiro is replaced by Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).

60' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) shows good awareness inside the box to meet a delightful cross from the free kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
60' The referee awards a corner and Luka Modric (Real Madrid) goes over to take it.
60' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Real Madrid will have a corner.
59' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
59' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
58' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Thibaut Courtois intercepts the ball.
57' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
56' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was! The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.

56' Jasper Cillessen leaps like a salmon to deny Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net.

55' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
54' A snap shot by Rodrygo (Real Madrid) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Jasper Cillessen produces a good save to thwart him.
54' Marvin (Las Palmas) serves up a nice cross, but Thibaut Courtois punches the ball away.
52' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

52' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal. Corner kick. Real Madrid will have an opportunity.

51' What an amazing save by Jasper Cillessen! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but fails.
50' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.

47' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Carlo Ancelotti decided to make a change. Ferland Mendy is replaced by Fran Garcia (Real Madrid).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Brahim Diaz is replaced by Rodrygo (Real Madrid).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
45+1' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Good work from Real Madrid as they win a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Real Madrid are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
42' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
41' Jose Campana (Las Palmas) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
40' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
38' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) glances on a header from the corner sent into the near post, but his close-range effort is blocked by a defender.
38' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

38' A snap shot by Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Jasper Cillessen produces a good save to thwart him. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
36' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
36' Real Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
35' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 51:49.
33' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

32' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
31' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.

29' Great solo effort by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) as he tricks his way through the defence before firing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. Jasper Cillessen is alert and denies him.

27' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
26' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
25' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) almost scores with a cheeky low shot towards goal that goes under the defensive wall, but Jasper Cillessen is alert and makes a good save.
25' Poor challenge! Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is penalised for tripping and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle. Real Madrid get a free kick.
24' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
23' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid). The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Real Madrid.
22' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

21' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
19' Good clearance! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
18' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.

16' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
15' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) superbly chips the ball over a defender inside the box to feed Ferland Mendy in stride, but one of the defenders manages to clear the ball.
15' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
12' Neat passing move from Real Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
10' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.

10' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Thibaut Courtois easily makes the save.

9' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. It's a throw-in for Real Madrid.
9' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
8' Marvin (Las Palmas) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
7' The resulting corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is cleared by the defence.

7' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
5' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) was set free in the area by Oliver McBurnie and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
4' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
4' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
2' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) commits a rough foul. Mateo Busquets Ferrer stops the game and makes a call.
1' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Real Madrid will kick the game off.
Mateo Busquets Ferrer will officiate today.
